name: Dead River Prelude
source:
Witches can live for over 1000 years. During that time witches can experience intense traumas, multiple heartbreaks, and more. Dead River (TBA) takes place in modern day, but this game is a prequel, set in the past to show the earlier days of Elana, Tanya, and Abraham.

[From [url=https://ink-ribbon.itch.io/dead-river-prelude]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
女巫的寿命可以超过1000岁。在此期间，女巫可能会经历严重的创伤、多次心碎等等。《死河》（TBA）的故事发生在现代，但这款游戏是前传，以过去为背景，展示了埃拉娜、坦尼娅和亚伯拉罕的早期生活。

[来自[url=https://ink-ribbon.itch.io/dead-river-prelude]Itch.io[/url]]
